title: Getting started with your first project
summary: Set up a workspace, create a project, and share your first proposal.
excerpts: To get started, create a workspace with your studio's name. Choose New Project, enter the project name and client name, and set a target date. Projects start as private drafts.
Add a proposal and the first set of deliverables to your project. When the proposal is ready, publish it and invite the client from the Client Portal tab.
